verses: Aey woh logo jo eman laye ho! meray aur (khud) apney dushmanon ko apna dost na banao tum to dosti say unn ki taraf paygham bhejtay ho aur woh uss haq kay sath jo tumharay pass chuka hai kufur kertay hain, payghumbar ko aur khud tumhen bhi mehaz uss wajah say jila-watan kertay hain kay tum apney rab per eman rakhtay ho, agar tum meri raah mein jihad kay liye aur meri raza mandi ki talab mein nikaltay ho (to unn say dostiyan na kero), tum unn kay pass mohabbat ka paygham posheedah posheedah bhejtay ho aur mujhay khoob maloom hai jo tum ney chupaya aur woh bhi jo tum ney zahir kiya, tum mein say jo bhi uss kaam ko keray ga woh yaqeenan raah raast say behak jaye ga

Agar woh tum per kahen qaboo paalen to woh tumharay (khulay) dushman ho jayen aur buraee kay sath tum per dast darazi aur zaban darazi kerney lagen aur (dil say) chahaney lagen kay tum bhi kufur kerney lag jao
Tumhari qarabaten, rishtedariyan, aur aulad tumhen qayamat kay din kaam na aayen gi, Allah Taalaa tumharay darmiyan faisla ker dey ga aur jo kuch tum ker rahey ho ussay Allah khoob dekh raha hai

(musalmano!) tumharay liye hazrat Ibrahim mein aur unn kay sathiyon mein behtareen namoona hai, jabkay unn sab ney apni qom say barmala keh diya kay hum tum say aur jin jin ki tum Allah kay siwa ibadat kertay ho unn sab say bilkul beyzaar hain. Hum tumharay (aqaeed kay) munkir hain jab tak tum Allah ki wahadaniyat per eman na lao hum mein tum mein hamesha kay liye bughz o adawat zahir hogaee lekin Ibrahim ki itni baat to apney baap say hui thi kay mein tumharay liye istaghfaar zaroor keroon ga aur tumharay liye mujhay Allah kay samney kissi cheez ka ikhtiyar kuch bhi nahi. Aey humaray perwerdigar tujhi per hum ney bharosa kiya hai aur teri hi taraf rujoo kertay hain aur teri hi taraf lotna hai
Aey humaray rab! to humen kafiron ki aazmaeesh mein na daal aur aey humaray paalney walay humari khataon ko bakhsh dey, be-shak to hi ghalib, hikmat wala hai

Yaqeenan tumharay liye unn mein acha namoona (aur umdah pairwee hai khaas ker) her uss shakhs kay liye jo Allah ki aur qayamat kay din ki mulaqat ki umeed rakhta ho, aur agar koi roo-gardani keray to Allah Taalaa bilkul bey-niaz hai aur saza waar hamd o sana hai
Kiya ajab kay unqareeb hi Allah Taalaa tum mein aur tumharay dushmanon mein mohabbat peda ker dey. Allah ko sab qudraten hain aur Allah (bara) ghafoor raheem hai

Jin logon ney tum say deen kay baray mein laraee nahi lari aur tumhen jila-watan nahi kiya unn kay sath salook o ehsan kerney aur munsifana bhalay bartao kerney say Allah Taalaa tumhen nahi rokta, balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa to insaf kerney walon say mohabbat kerta hai

Allah Taalaa tumhen sirf unn logon ki mohabbat say rokta hai jinhon ney tum say deen kay baray mein laraiyan laren aur tumhen shehar say nikal diye aur shehar say nikalney walon ki madad ki jo log aisay kuffaar say mohabbat keren woh (qata’an) zalim hain

Aey eman walo! jab tumharay pass momin aurten hijrat kerkay aayen to tum unn ka imtehan lo. Dar-asal unn kay eman ko bakhoobi jannay wala to Allah hi hai lekin agar woh tumhen eman waliyan maloom hun to abb tum unhen kafiron ki taraf wapis na kero, yeh unn kay liye halal nahi aur na woh unn kay liye halal hain, aur jo kharach unn kafiron ka hua ho woh unhen ada kerdo, unn aurton ko unn kay mehar dey ker unn say nikkah ker lenay mein tum per koi gunah nahi aur kafir aurton ki namoos apney qabzay mein na rakho aur jo kuch tum ney kharach kiya ho, maang lo aur jo kuch unn kafiron ney kharach kiya ho woh bhi maang len yeh Allah ka faisla hai jo tumharay darmiyan ker raha hai, Allah Taalaa baray ilm (aur) hikmat wala hai

Aur agar tumhari koi biwi tumharay hath say nikal jaye aur kafiron kay pass chali jaye phir tumhen uss kay badlay ka waqt mill jaye to jin ki biwiyan chali gaee hain unhen unn kay ikhraajaat kay barabar ada ker do, aur uss Allah Taalaa say dartay raho jiss per tum eman rakhtay ho

Aey payghumbar! jab musalman aurten aap say unn baaton per bait kerney aayen kay woh Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek na keren gi, chori na keren gi, zinna kaari na keren gi, apni aulad ko na maar dalen gi aur koi aisa bohtan na bandhen gi jo khud apney hathon pairon kay samney gharr len aur kissi nek kaam mein teri hukmi na keren gi to aap unn say bait ker liya keren, aur unn kay liye Allah say maghfirat talab keren be-shak Allah Taalaa bakhshney aur moaf kerney wala hai
Aey musalmano! tum uss qom say dosti na rakho jin per Allah ka ghazab nazil chuka hai jo aakhirat say uss tarah mayyus chukay hain jaisay kay murdah ahl qabar say kafir na-umeed hain
